messages:
maria_cs: Reminder  dedicated bring-up for Scarab tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need final quota, autoscale policy, loadtest window, and KMS rotation time. @sam_engineering @priya_sre

sam_engineering: Quota: 50k tokens/min across 3 reserved slots. Start with 3 workers, burst to 6. Billing tag=scarab-dedicated-2026. Will open infra PR with config today.

priya_sre: SRE recommendations: min_replicas=2, autoscale cpu_target=60%, token_rate_window=30s, cooldown=90s. Run 20m shadow canary before real traffic. KMS rotation scheduled at 10:45 PT to avoid ramp.

maria_cs: Customer requests fallback plan if pool saturates. Suggest routing to gpt-neox-20b-quant (higher latency, lower cost). Eli, can you validate routing and perf delta?

eli_cloud_ops: Confirmed route and compatibility. Fallback adds ~350ms median latency; documented in runbook. Set routing priority so primary used when available.

sam_engineering: Infra PR includes cache warmup hooks and routing. Warmup job runs at T-15 and T-5. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"scarab-primary","prefixes":["Hi","Order status"]}'
```

ops_bot: Reservation created: loadtest-scarab-281234 (10:00-11:30 UTC). Pool lock applied, incident channel reserved: #eng-oncall.

maria_cs: Run timeline: 09:30 sync, 09:40 warmup, 09:50 shadow canary 20m, 10:15 ramp 50% obs check, 10:30 full loadtest, 10:45 KMS rotate (if green), 11:15 postmortem. Any blockers?

priya_sre: Blocker: confirm no serving fleet deploys 09:00-12:00 PT. Need release team ack.

sam_engineering: We'll hold deploys; I'll notify release ops and attach loadtest script here.

maria_cs: Also capture 48h P95 and tail error counts to console dashboards and export daily CSVs for CS.

eli_cloud_ops: Dashboard created under Scarab > Health > Latency+Errors. Daily exports enabled.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll send the customer prep email tonight. Closing unless new issues. :white_check_mark:
